## Description

Sell an out-of-the-money call spread and put spread to collect premium within a defined range.

## Where it may fit

Range-bound markets with implied volatility rich to subsequent realized volatility.

## Vehicles

Options-income portfolios, volatility funds and defined-risk option strategies.

## Required data

Option chains, implied volatility surface, Greeks, strike/expiry liquidity, margin and transaction costs.

## Caveats

Defined risk does not mean small risk; gap moves, skew, fills and multiple-leg slippage matter.
